newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 6.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
NOW ANOTHER MP HAS MAJOR ON THE ROPES

John Major's hopes of relaunching his party's election chances with a stand on family values have been blown off course by allegations against prominent Conservative backbencher Jerry Hayes that he had a gay relationship with an under-age Conservative party researcher in the early nineties.
PAYOUT PLUS IN THE WOOLWICH FLOTATION
Savers and borrowers with the Woolwich building society are to get an average of 1,233 stg when the society converts to a bank this summer, approximately 25 percent more than the expected 1,000 stg.
SOUTH AFRICANS SET TO TAKE OVER CARR SHEPPARD

Stockbroking firm Carr Sheppard was today on the verge of changing ownership from Banque Indosuez to South African financial conglomerate Investec, nearly a year after Indosuez put the business up for sale.
